Thanks for the heads up, Sara — totally understandable. We're happy to shift. To make sure we cover everything given the attendee changes, a couple of quick questions and a proposed cadence below:

1) Do you want a single combined session (console + API) or two focused sessions (console walkthrough + separate API lab)?
2) Who will be the primary attendees for the API lab — devs only, or product + devs?

Proposed options (pick one):
- Option A (single day): Sep 24, 13:00–16:00 ET — 45m console overview + 2h API lab (hands-on).
- Option B (split): Sep 24, 13:00–14:00 ET — Console primer (60m); Sep 25, 13:00–15:00 ET — API integration lab (90m).
- Backup: Sep 26 afternoon ET any 13:00–16:00 slot.

Operational notes:
- We'll provide a short runbook and test sandbox credentials in advance. (Camila, Ben — can you confirm runbook version and sandbox readiness?)
- If you prefer a tighter console segment, we can compress to 45m focused on ACLs, routing policies, and rollout controls.

If you confirm Option A or B and attendee list, I'll lock the calendar and share prep materials.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
